messages.subject: Matthijs | Director-Level External Affairs & ESG Executive | Global Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Matthijs,

I am reaching out because your Talent Acquisition role at Roche makes you a relevant contact for senior profiles entering regulated multinational environments from adjacent sectors.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. My strongest fit is in leadership roles where institutional trust, sustainability, public-sector engagement and disciplined execution affect growth and reputation.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Corporate Affairs, Government Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation and expatriate assignments.

I have attached a Roche-tailored executive CV for review. I would value consideration for relevant current or upcoming mandates, or referral to the appropriate regional hiring lead.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
